dimensions.assessment: Directs federal departments, agencies, and public commenters participating in the review process, with indirect future implications for foreign investors and domestic businesses.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Commerce and the Comptroller General of the Government Accountability Office... shall conduct an interagency review

dimensions.assessment: The immediate effect is administrative, consisting of a study, public notices, and a report to Congress.
dimensions.evidence: conduct an interagency review of and report to Congress on ways to increase the global competitiveness of the United States in attracting foreign direct investment.

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state any specific appropriations or funding amounts for conducting the study.
Establishes a temporary reporting and review requirement for the Department of Commerce and GAO, explicitly excluding changes to CFIUS laws.
dimensions.evidence: The review conducted pursuant to subsection (a) shall not address laws or policies relating to the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States.

dimensions.assessment: Requires a one-time report to be submitted to Congress not later than one year after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary... shall submit to Congress a report

missing_information: Exact costs associated with conducting the interagency study and public notice process are not provided.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs federal agencies to conduct a study and report to Congress on foreign direct investment competitiveness, without changing underlying laws or imposing new permanent regulations.
